candidates.description: This vector represents characters, locations, and terminology from the Harry Potter universe.
This vector represents adverbial and nominal suffixes, particularly those related to the "-mente" (ly) adverbial form and "-mento" nominal form in Romance languages.
This vector represents various conjugated forms and tenses of the Portuguese and Spanish verb "to be" (ser).
This vector represents Portuguese words and morphological suffixes containing the root "iv" or "ativ".
This feature represents literary and media works, publications, and entertainment content across multiple languages.
This feature vector activates on tokens associated with proper nouns, foreign words, and diverse stylistic or multilingual subword fragments.
Spanish words and text fragments starting with the letters "es" or "esc".
Portuguese action verbs indicating various states, processes, and intentional activities.
This vector activates on tokens containing the letter sequence "ver" or variations associated with diverse word roots.
This feature vector activates strongly on tokens containing the letters "iv" or "lv" across various root words and prefixes.
